profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Detail-oriented, organized and meticulous employee. Works at a fast pace to meet tight deadlines. Enthusiastic team player ready to contribute to company success.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: HP NonStop · Java · Spring Framework

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer: Web Application and Test Automation
positions.description:
Ad Tech Platform – Attribution & Campaign Analytics

Developed a React-based Attribution UI for Samsung’s Demand Side Platform (DSP), empowering advertisers to track conversions and evaluate campaign effectiveness in real time.

Implemented automated testing frameworks with Appium and Selenium, ensuring seamless cross-platform compatibility across Android phone, tablet, and desktop browsers.

Contributed to full-stack development leveraging React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Ruby on Rails, accelerating feature delivery, while maintaining high code quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Test Automation with Appium/Selenium · Java/Java Script/Node.js/React/PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer: Android App Development and Testing
positions.description:
Retail Experience Solutions – Samsung Galaxy Devices

Developed and tested the Retail Mode APK to showcase immersive demo content on flagship Galaxy devices in retail environments.

Led development of Live Demo Unit (LDU) models, deployed across major U.S. retail chains (Best Buy, Costco, Walmart, Target, etc) and thousands of carrier stores, driving customer engagement and product visibility in the store.

Enabled cross-platform product experiences across Samsung’s ecosystem—including Galaxy smartphones, watches, VR/AR, TVs, and Family Hub refrigerators—enhancing the demo experience and brand loyalty.

positions.title: Staff Software QA Engineer: Software Quality Assurance on Galaxy Devices
positions.description:
Software Engineering Tools & Open-Source Compliance

Enhanced code quality and maintainability by leading static, dynamic, and architectural analysis initiatives using industry-standard tools (Klocwork, Coverity Scan, SonarQube).

Ensured open-source compliance in commercial applications through rigorous validation of third-party components with Black Duck Protex IP, mitigating legal and regulatory risks.

Spearheaded Jenkins CI/CD pipeline implementations, seamlessly integrating with Git, Mercurial, and Perforce to automate builds and streamline deployments.

Championed Agile practices and Wiki-based knowledge sharing across globally distributed teams, improving collaboration and knowledge retention.

Coordinated independent testing resources, strengthening cross-functional alignment and accelerating project delivery.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer: Radio Access Network
positions.description:
3G CDMA Base Station (250 base stations in Puerto Rico market)

Developed a PLD Manager in Java to efficiently store and manage air interface and critical system parameters.

Led version-to-version PLD migrations, enabling the successful launch of Puerto Rico’s mobile network with 250 base stations and 10 base controller systems.

Designed Grow/De-Grow functionality to dynamically provision and decommission base stations in a live network.

Optimized RF performance parameters, reducing call block rates and drops while improving handoff success ratios.

Femto Cell Validation & Deployment

Validated functional requirements for Samsung Femtocell running on 800Mhz Verizon/1900Mhz Sprint spectrums.

Integrated Network Management Server and Security Gateway, enabling secure, dynamic RF services for residential use.

Conducted comprehensive performance testing of Assisted GPS, IPSec, HA clusters, and VoIP core product services.

Contributed to large-scale deployment, supporting sales of millions of units to major U.S. telecom carriers.

positions.title: Software Engineer: SS7 Core Network
positions.description:
Conducted in-depth code reviews of GTE PSTN source code, resolving critical Y2K defects by modernizing legacy year formats.

Validated and optimized Value-Added Services on the HP NonStop platform, including Caller Name, Enhanced 911 Call Forwarding, Global VPN, and 1-800 Toll-Free services.

Delivered critical support for SMS, Call Forwarding, Call Waiting, and Voicemail features under the ANSI-41 protocol, ensuring reliability within the Intelligent Network infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: HP NonStop · Value-Added Services (VAS) · Intelligent Networks · Signaling System 7 (SS7) · Linux Server · Solaris and Oracle Database

positions.title: Software Engineer: CDMA HLR Core System
positions.description:
Implemented a high-performance in-memory DBMS to optimize data retrieval performance of CDMA subscriber data within Home Location Register (HLR) and Authentication Center (AuC) systems.

Developed database utilities including storage backup, database recovery, and an SQL command compiler, strengthening data integrity and operational reliability.

Engineered a real-time maintenance UI for alarm and fault reporting, significantly improving system monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: UNIX C and Shell Script (Sun Solaris) · CDMA IS-41 call processing · Main-memory DBMS (HLR/AC) · SS7 fault tolerant server (Stratus Technologies)

Femto cells and Network Management Server
